def trump_detector(text):
    vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
    text_lower = text.lower()
    
    # Extract only vowels from the text
    vowel_sequence = [char for char in text_lower if char in vowels]
    
    if not vowel_sequence:
        return 0.0
    
    # Count total vowels
    total_vowels = len(vowel_sequence)
    
    # Find consecutive groups of identical vowels
    extra_vowels = 0
    base_groups = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(vowel_sequence):
        current_char = vowel_sequence[i]
        count = 1
        
        # Count how many times the same vowel repeats consecutively
        while i + count < len(vowel_sequence) and vowel_sequence[i + count] == current_char:
            count += 1
        
        # If more than one, add extras (count - 1)
        if count > 1:
            extra_vowels += (count - 1)
        
        # Each group counts as one base unit
        base_groups += 1
        
        i += count
    
    if base_groups == 0:
        return 0.0
    
    score = extra_vowels / base_groups
    return round(score, 2)
